fundamental.text: Crop model 11.75m bales vs USDA 13.18m (-11%), driven by Texas abandonment of 51% vs USDA's 34% on drought and poor ratings. fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 2.27¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,275/t (56th pct of 5 yrs). Brazil's election outcome weakened the real, improving mills' export returns and triggering fund selling that pushed raw sugar to new lows early in the week. Desk read: Brazil drives it: the post-election slide in the real raises mills' returns on exports in local currency and encourages sugar-heavy mixes, while raw sugar still pays above ethanol parity. Friday's bounce back over 18.4¢ is short covering on firmer crude, not a change in the Brazilian supply picture.
